requirements.title: DOT_PRODUCT vector argument restrictions
requirements.definition: VECTOR_A shall be a rank-one numeric or logical array; VECTOR_B shall have a compatible numeric or logical type, rank one, and the same size as VECTOR_A.

pending.DOT_PRODUCT-vector-a-type-rank: Positive plan calls DOT_PRODUCT with rank-one integer, complex, and logical VECTOR_A arrays; source-control mutation supplies a rank-two VECTOR_A and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.DOT_PRODUCT-vector-b-compatible-type-ran: Positive plan uses numeric/numeric and logical/logical pairs; source-control mutation pairs logical VECTOR_A with numeric VECTOR_B and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.DOT_PRODUCT-vector-b-same-size: Positive plan uses equal-size vectors; source-control mutation uses unequal extents and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: DOT_PRODUCT result characteristics are scalar expression characteristics
requirements.definition: A numeric DOT_PRODUCT result has the type and kind of VECTOR_A*VECTOR_B; a logical result has the kind of VECTOR_A .AND. VECTOR_B; the result is scalar.

pending.DOT_PRODUCT-numeric-result-expression-ty: Use integer*real and complex*complex rank-one vectors with distinct kinds and assert the result kind matches the corresponding expression kind; mutate an operand kind to change the expected kind.
pending.DOT_PRODUCT-logical-result-and-kind: Use logical vectors of a nondefault logical kind where available and assert KIND(DOT_PRODUCT(A,B)) equals KIND(A .AND. B); otherwise keep kind-specific branch guarded by kind availability.
pending.DOT_PRODUCT-result-scalar: Assign DOT_PRODUCT of nonempty rank-one arrays to a scalar initialized to a nonzero sentinel and mutate the expression to an array operation that cannot satisfy the scalar check.
